_comment: Released stable item ids — APPEND-ONLY (ADR-0006, 12r-a). The append-only-ids eval fails if any id here disappears from game-core/content/items/*.ron, and — since 12r-a — also fails if a LIVE id is not pinned here. Derived by reading the RON by hand in glob-sorted filename order (000-core.ron is the only part file: 1 Lure Berry, 2 Power Root, 3 Antidote · 4 Tidewell Shard and 5 Emberheart Cinder, the ADR-0176 D6 crystalized-essence sources = 5 ids), then cross-checked against parseIds — NEVER generated from parseIds, because a baseline derived from the extractor under test is self-confirming and forbidden. AUTHOR OBLIGATION: a content PR that adds an item id MUST append it here in the SAME PR; this list may only ever GROW, never shrink, and it carries an EXACT expected DISTINCT-id count (5 for items today) pinned in TWO places the eval reads independently — the production `BASELINE_ID_FLOORS` constant and the tooth-owned `baselineFloor` table — BOTH of which that same PR must bump. It is an exact pin, not a minimum: a count below it means a baseline was shrunk, so restore the content and the pin (never lower the number to match); a count above it means content grew without the ratchet. That is what closes the self-consistent 'delete the content and un-pin it in one commit' shrink, the add-one/retire-one swap that leaves the count unmoved, and duplicate or `-0` padding (which inflates the array's length while `Set` collapses it) — every entry here must be a DISTINCT plain integer. SCOPE LIMIT — this gate detects id REMOVAL and UNPINNED GROWTH only, NEVER id REUSE or rebinding: swapping 4 and 5, or reusing id 4 for an entirely different item, stays green (catching that needs a map-shaped baseline like evolution-path-edge-ids.json — a named follow-up). parseIds is also flat and depth-blind, so a nested `id:` sub-record inside an item entry is now a HARD FAIL with NO correct remediation: its number is harvested as a live id, and neither answer is right — pinning it writes a non-id into an append-only baseline permanently, and rewriting it as `id=N` (the convention for prose) is not valid RON for a real field, so the loader returns Err. Do NOT pin it and do NOT mangle the field; that needs a depth-aware extractor in its own slice.
